pitch: Safely install, research, plan, connect, configure, and verify QuipBot without exposing credentials to the agent.
problem: A useful chatbot needs grounded business knowledge, approved wording, consent, escalation rules, and a testable launch decision.
Chat-based setup often tempts people to paste WordPress passwords or provider keys into the AI conversation.
This skill separates human authorization from agent work and stores only non-secret, reviewable setup artifacts.

flow.d: Confirm authority, official installation, compatibility, and recovery.
Read public pages and cite the facts.
Collect only owner decisions the site cannot answer.
Keep WordPress credentials outside the transcript.
Guide the human through the approved wp-admin plan.
Expose passes, failures, and blockers before launch.

commands: Set up QuipBot on my WordPress site
Research my site before configuring QuipBot
Help me plan the QuipBot knowledge base
Connect this WordPress site to the Quip setup flow
Review whether QuipBot is ready to go live

callout.label: Public alpha
callout.text: Human-guided WordPress setup and verification work now. **Direct agent writes remain blocked** until the stable public API and OS-native helper ship.

items.name: Cold-start preflight
items.desc: Checks official installation, versions, environment, backup, rollback, and visibility.

items.name: Public-site research
items.desc: Produces cited facts, unknowns, and confirmation questions.

items.name: Owner decisions
items.desc: Records knowledge, consent, voice, handoff, and launch authority.

items.name: Configuration plan
items.desc: Maps every proposed field to a source and verification method.

items.name: Guided WordPress setup
items.desc: Walks the human through QuipBot admin without observing the authenticated browser.

items.name: Direct agent writes
items.desc: Waits for the stable public setup API and credential helper.

limits.label: Safety boundaries
items: No WordPress passwords, Application Passwords, provider keys, or tokens in chat.
No browser automation, SSH, XML-RPC, direct database writes, or internal admin routes.
No arbitrary plugin package, no production change without backup, and no go-live without explicit approval.
